headline: Turkish Regulator Suspends Operations at Tera and Pusula Asset Managers
summary: The Capital Markets Board of Turkey temporarily suspended capital market activities for Tera Portföy Yönetimi and Pusula Portföy Yönetimi.
why: SPK regulates Turkish capital markets to maintain investor protection and compliance across domestic financial institutions.

impacts.name: Asset Management
impacts.why: Regulatory suspensions temporarily halt capital deployment and investor operations at affected funds.
